title: Grass Roots: Positioning Cardano as the Swiss L1 of Choice

ms.promise:
・Our CEO is the former Executive Director of the Crypto Valley Association. We'll leverage his contacts within the organization and its members to measure their familiarity, opinion, and interactions with the Cardano network, as well as what in their estimation would make Cardano stronger within its areas of focus.
・Similarly, since Cardano has a lot of utility in the area of governance, we'll talk to our contacts within DAO Suisse to get similar feedback as in point one, and particularly in the case they don't use Cardano what are the key differentiators or what would make them consider crossing over.
・We'll compile a report on our findings. It's difficult to quantify how much outreach will be necessary: if we get a very coherent signal-to-noise ratio here, we can focus our efforts more on the implementation, whereas a lack of convergence or competing theories will require more testing.

Next Submission: Milestone 5 (Final Milestone) 
Milestone Outputs:
・Comprehensive Marketing Best-Practice Guide: A detailed marketing best-practice guide will be created, consolidating insights, strategies, and key learnings from previous events, workshops, and pilot initiatives. This guide will be tailored to meet the needs of startups and individuals with limited marketing experience, ensuring they can apply effective marketing techniques independently. The guide will be published digitally in an accessible format to maximize its reach and usability for the Swiss Cardano community and beyond.
・Targeted Promotion Campaign for the Marketing Guide: A dedicated social media promotion campaign will be launched to raise awareness of the marketing guide. This campaign will utilize platforms popular within the Cardano ecosystem, such as X (formerly Twitter), LinkedIn, and relevant Discord channels. The promotional strategy will include visually engaging posts, key takeaways from the guide, and direct calls to action encouraging community members—for those in Switzerland—to explore and adopt the guide’s practices.

ms.promise:
・A comprehensive marketing best-practice guide containing the knowledge and learnings from the events and pilots to enable the Swiss Cardano community to sustain its own growth. The guide will be intended for startups and non-professionals to be able to implement, and it will be published digitally.
・Promoting the guide on social media, targeting the Cardano community in Switzerland and elsewhere.
ms.criteria:
・The guide should contain recommendations on methods, metrics on how those methods performed during the testing phases, and an overall recommendation for the Swiss Cardano community to implement during the next year. It may or may not include direct contributions from DAO Suisse or the CVA--They will have to decide, but we'll welcome the contribution. The guide will be made publicly available as either a public notion page or an equivalent accessible medium.
・Social posts promoting the guide.
